description: Crawl registry for Workflow A. Every entry describes one public page that lists personal loan products. Adding a source here (plus an extractor) is enough to extend the crawler - no workflow change required.

bankbazaar.name: BankBazaar
bankbazaar.note: Comparison page with one card per lender, so a single crawl yields many products.

bajaj-finserv.name: Bajaj Finserv
bajaj-finserv.note: Direct lender. The main page carries schema.org product markup, the variant pages are read from the rendered text.

sources.name: BankBazaar Personal Loan Comparison
sources.notes: Comparison page with one card per lender (16-17 products per crawl). Rates, amounts, tenure and the eligibility bullets are read from the rendered cards.

sources.name: Bajaj Finserv Personal Loan
sources.notes: schema.org LoanOrCredit/FinancialProduct markup gives the interest rate range, loan amount range, tenure and the eligible employment types; CIBIL score and maximum age come from the rendered text.

sources.name: Bajaj Finserv Personal Loan for Salaried Professionals
sources.notes: Segment specific variant. No schema.org product markup, so the heading, amount, tenure and CIBIL requirement are read from the page.

sources.name: Bajaj Finserv Personal Loan for Travel
sources.notes: Purpose specific variant for travel expenses.

sources.name: Bajaj Finserv Personal Loan for Wedding
sources.notes: Purpose specific variant for wedding expenses.

sources.name: Bajaj Finserv Personal Loan for Medical Emergency
sources.notes: Purpose specific variant for medical expenses.

sources.name: Bajaj Finserv Personal Loan for Home Expenses
sources.notes: Purpose specific variant for home improvement and renovation.

sources.name: Bajaj Finserv Personal Loan for Higher Education
sources.notes: Purpose specific variant for higher education fees.
